rule: Close only the genuine B5 acid-base Source Gap and the duplicated K+/H+ owner. Preserve all 20 stable KP ids and the existing Lecture-owned water/Na/K/Ca exam content. External sources have narrow authority only for expected compensation, AG correction/delta analysis and mixed-disorder diagnosis.

repairs.target: urinary-b05-kp15 and all duplicated K+/H+ recall/reconstruction/exit text
actions: Remove the universal four-grid/paradoxical-urine model as learner-canonical truth.
Make B3 the sole owner of tubular K+/H+ coupling semantics; B5 recalls/applies it clinically.
Require context gates before predicting serum K or urine pH: primary disturbance, ECF volume/aldosterone, distal Na delivery/flow, ammonium excretion and renal function.
Keep classic high-K/low-K and paradoxical-urine examples only as source-specific patterns, not universal laws.
Stored blood: hyperkalaemia route = storage lesion/K+ leakage or extracellular-supernatant K load; alkalosis route = citrate metabolism to bicarbonate. Keep the two mechanisms separate.
Mark the previous complete-compensation/mixed-disorder Source Gap RESOLVED_BY_ADMITTED_EXTERNAL_SOURCE; do not erase its provenance.

Add expected compensation for all four simple disorders: metabolic acidosis Winter formula; metabolic alkalosis expected PaCO2 slope/range; acute/chronic respiratory acidosis HCO3- response; acute/chronic respiratory alkalosis HCO3- response.
Teach that compensation does not overshoot the primary pH disturbance; measured compensation outside the expected range implies an additional primary process or an incorrect acute/chronic assumption.
Add AG = Na - (Cl + HCO3-); if albumin is low, use admitted albumin correction.

For HAGMA, add delta-gap/corrected-HCO3 and admitted delta-ratio logic: <1 concurrent NAGMA direction; 1-2 uncomplicated HAGMA direction; >2 concurrent metabolic alkalosis/pre-existing high HCO3- direction.

Add the final algorithm: danger first -> pH -> primary candidate -> expected compensation -> AG/albumin correction if metabolic acidosis -> delta analysis if HAGMA -> list every primary disorder -> reconcile with clinical context.
Existing project Lectures remain Primary for 306 water/electrolyte/Ca/renal acid-handling content.
MSD Manual Professional is supplementary Current authority only for expected compensation and mixed-disorder detection.
NCBI/StatPearls is supplementary only for albumin-corrected AG and delta-ratio interpretation.
Do not import hyponatraemia correction rates, DKA/HHS treatment, bicarbonate therapy, ventilator management or broad ICU/nephrology treatment from the external sources.
